content: We evaluated the performance of Jasper on two read speech datasets: LibriSpeech and Wall Street Journal (WSJ). For LibriSpeech, we trained Jasper DR 10x5 using our NovoGrad optimizer for 400 epochs. We achieve SOTA performance on the test-clean subset and SOTA among end-to-end speech recognition models on test-other.
